annotations.text:
Direction: technical editorial.
Warm paper, Newsreader for prose, IBM Plex Mono for anything numeric.
The palette carries the pedagogy: blue = accounting (not arguable), amber = assumption (arguable), green = accumulation.

Low-fi alternate on a different axis: model-first, dark, notebook-like.
Denser and more instrument-like; worse for 28 minutes of reading.
Here to compare against, not to ship.
This one has working controls — pick a direction for all three and the Run button unlocks, then it reveals what actually happened. Everything else is a static mockup.
